bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of nine different label imputation strategies for indeterminate lower-court (Chamber) decisions on the predictive behavior and performance (via Matthews Correlation Coefficient) of a Longformer model classifying European Court of Human Rights cases.

Measuring the effect of entirely excluding indeterminate cases from the training data, and attempting to correct the resulting non-random sampling bias of appealed cases using inverse propensity weighting (the 'obs+ip' method) compared to baseline models.
